components.scope: Static catalog count only; not live hardware

components.scope: Authenticated agent identity, allowed capabilities, fresh heartbeat, revision and health

components.scope: Authorized runner execution and, separately, Windows Server 2025 guest boot
components.limitations: CI success on a hosted runner is not proof that Arkan or the VM is running

components.scope: Authenticated pool session, measured hashrate and accepted shares
components.limitations: Source code and CI do not prove mining or revenue; payout evidence is separate

components.scope: Keep RTL simulation, physical-design output, foundry acceptance and fabricated-silicon test as separate gates
